wikipedia.extract: Sasia is a genus of birds in the woodpecker family Picidae, that are native to the Old World. They are very small, virtually tailless woodpeckers, with a crombec or nuthatch-like appearance and foraging habits.
wikipedia.title: Sasia

wikipedia.extract: Brachyramphus is a small genus of seabirds from the North Pacific. Brachyramphus is from Ancient Greek brakhus, "short", and rhamphos, "bill".
wikipedia.title: Brachyramphus

wikipedia.extract: The golden-mantled tamarin (Leontocebus tripartitus) is a tamarin species from South America. It is found in Ecuador and Peru, specifically in the upper Amazon (lowland), east of the Andes in Ecuador, and Northeast Peru; between the Rio Curaray and Rio Napo in Peru.
wikipedia.title: Golden-mantled tamarin

wikipedia.extract: Abbott's booby (Papasula abbotti) is an endangered seabird of the sulid family, which includes gannets and boobies. It is a large booby and is placed within its own monotypic genus.
wikipedia.title: Abbott's booby

commonNames.name: Heck's Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Heck's macaque (Macaca hecki) is a macaque of Sulawesi, Indonesia. This Old World monkey is diurnal.
wikipedia.title: Heck's macaque

wikipedia.extract: Spilornis is a genus of bird of prey in the family Accipitridae. As adults all have dark crowns, and bright yellow eyes and cere.
wikipedia.title: Spilornis

wikipedia.extract: The capuchin monkeys () are New World monkeys of the subfamily Cebinae. They are famous for their complex foraging skills, such as tool use to crack open nuts.
wikipedia.title: Capuchin monkey

wikipedia.extract: Chiromyiformes is an infraorder of strepsirrhine primates that includes the aye-aye from Madagascar and its extinct relatives.
wikipedia.title: Chiromyiformes

wikipedia.extract: Geoffroyus is a genus of parrot in the family Psittaculidae. The four species are found in and around New Guinea, the Solomon Islands, northern Australia and the islands of Indonesia.
wikipedia.title: Geoffroyus

commonNames.name: Dusky Scrubfowl
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The dusky megapode (Megapodius freycinet), also known as dusky scrubfowl or common megapode, is a medium-sized, approximately 41 cm (16 in) long, blackish bird with a short pointed crest, bare red facial skin, dark legs, brown irises, and a dark brown and yellow bill. The male and female are similar.
wikipedia.title: Dusky megapode

wikipedia.extract: Bacillus subtilis, known also as the hay bacillus or grass bacillus, is a Gram-positive, catalase-positive bacterium, found in soil and the gastrointestinal tract of ruminants, humans, and marine sponges. Bacillus subtilis is motile and amylase-positive.
wikipedia.title: Bacillus subtilis

commonNames.name: Groves’ Titi
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Plecturocebus grovesi Boubli, Byrne, Silva, Silva-Júnior, Costa Araujo, Bertuol, Gonçalves, Melo, Rylands et al., 2019

wikipedia.extract: The Alta Floresta titi monkey (Plecturocebus grovesi), also known as the Groves's titi monkey, is a species of titi monkey, a type of New World monkey, endemic to Brazil. It was described from the municipality of Alta Floresta in the state of Mato Grosso.
wikipedia.title: Alta Floresta titi monkey
